name: semantic-crosscheck
description: Cross-layer verification for an ontology plus semantic layer on PostgreSQL 17, for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Prove that a PostgreSQL closure, SHACL rules, OWL reasoning and a Cube model agree.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.6.0: cross-checks PostgreSQL 17 closures, SQL and SHACL rules, OWL/HermiT and Cube against gold SQL. Verifies report-mode cycle closures independently after strongly connected component edge removal, compares shapes that combine class with bounds through SHACL with a separate value predicate, and adds a bounded-exhaustive BOM scenario judged exactly by the independent closure oracle. Errors, bounded agreement, missing or changed evidence cannot establish a PASS. Existing version 1 configurations and dependency pins remain supported. Rerun the whole pipeline (build first, then reason, cube and verify) after upgrading; no shared MVCC snapshot across Cube or stages or runtime attestation is claimed.
defaultPrompt: Use semantic-crosscheck to run the synthetic demo end to end.
Use semantic-crosscheck to verify my crosscheck.toml against PostgreSQL and explain what is not proven.
